content: Suppose comparator times out the standard github runners. Is a registrant just outta luck? What message is surfaced?
I think that they will see an error to that effect. I've haven't actually tried this yet, but we should. We should also get some bigger runners.

They should see:

Palomar could not complete mechanical verification. This is a fault at our end, not with your submission.

Under “Verification needs attention”:

worker wall-clock capacity was exhausted; retry on a longer-running worker
Palomar must fix this.
Next: Do not change the repository. Retry the same commit later.

(This assumes that some code attempting to stop the submission at the 5.5 hour mark works. If it doesn't, and Github just kills the job, the structured report won't be generated and they'll just get "Palomar could not retrieve the detailed failure report." So we do need to test this.)

Hello! I've just run into this exact error in a submission of mine, getting the expected messages above. Is there any way to request a bigger runner if they're available? (I don't believe I'll be able to get my submission below the 5.5 hour limit.) Thank you!
@Dean Cureton still working on this, hopefully we'll have a solution soon.
